messages:
ana: quick ask for launch collateral + webinar next week. we need validated headline numbers but prefer conservative estimates. request: p95/p99 token latency, coldstart heatmap, and a long-context tail check for quantized-n4 and float16 baseline.

sam: understood. which region, payloads, and artifact set?

ana: us-east-2. payloads: (1) 40-word pitch, (2) 1.6k-token policy excerpt + summarize to 120 words, (3) implementation plan prompt. traffic: small conservative profile: 40 qps for 10m. include separate warmup=180s bucket for conservative numbers and a short-warmup=90s bucket for context. artifacts: latencies.csv, heatmap.png, samples.json (8 per prompt), manifest with model hash and seeds. exclude KV dumps.

leo: do you want both runtime variants back-to-back to avoid infra drift?

ana: yes—run quantized-n4 then float16 immediately after. label buckets clearly. marketing will use the 180s numbers in the press materials and show the 90s numbers in the appendix.

maria: include RNG seeds, exact commit hash, S3 path, and a one-line methodology blurb I can paste into the blog. also a CSV header for slides.

sam: plan: staging cluster, seeds 5,17,233; warmup buckets 90s & 180s; measurement 10m each; induce 3 coldstarts per window by restarting workers. s3 target: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1881234567-conservative-warmup/. will add a reproducible CLI snippet in manifest.

benchbot: Scheduled bench job rb-1881234567 on staging for 2024-08-30T02:30:00Z. ETA artifacts ~45m after completion.

leo: note: quantized-n4 shows warmup sensitivity; recommend marketing use 180s numbers for public claims.

sam: running now.

benchbot: rb-1881234567 COMPLETE. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1881234567-conservative-warmup/{manifest.txt,latencies.csv,heatmap.png,samples.json}. Summary (180s warmup measurement): quantized-n4 p95=76ms p99=185ms; float16 p95=69ms p99=160ms. Short-warmup (90s) summary: quantized-n4 p95=82ms p99=240ms. Coldstart first-token spikes: median ~0.62s (180s warmup) vs ~0.95s (90s warmup).

maria: pulling artifacts and drafting the methodology blurb. will use 180s numbers in headline and mention warmup sensitivity in the notes.

ana: thanks—exact wording well use in the press: "Headline numbers reflect a conservative 180s warmup; shorter warmups can increase tail latency, particularly for quantized variants." flag any >20% regressions vs last public run.

sam: quick diff vs last-public: quantized-n4 p99 (180s) is +4% — within tolerance. marking run manifest with sequencing notes and CLI for reproducibility.

ana: perfect. please put the manifest link in the draft and cc eng if anything above 15% appears. thanks team :rocket:
